name: S57 declares the requires_binary environment guard — meta-lock, S340 pattern (PHASE-55 W-3, closes PHASE-54 R-14)
description: Locks S57's requires_binary declaration ('pip3', fixed by the R-17 measurement: both pip3 and pip probed SUCCESS on the owner's machine; pip3 mirrors pip_adapter.js:22's primary choice) so the environment guard cannot silently disappear, plus core-shape pins (direct_tool pkg.install, pip adapter, >=5 assertions) so the lock cannot be satisfied by gutting the real Tier-1 scenario. The guard's runtime skip semantics are already locked by the five docker scenarios (scenario_runner.js:914-924); the environmental RED/GREEN legs (S57 FAIL under a Python-stripped PATH before the declaration, SKIP after) are captured in checkpoint C3 per R-2.
